use.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information

sharing.heading: 3. Data Sharing

rights.heading: 5. Your Rights

updates.heading: 7. Updates to This Policy

contact.heading: 8. Contact Us
contact.lead: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

a11y.heading: 9. Accessibility Preferences
a11y.body: If you use the accessibility options on this site (text size, contrast, line spacing, fonts, or self-voicing), your choices are stored in a cookie on your own device so the site can apply them on your next visit. This is a functional cookie: it holds only your display preferences, is never used for advertising or analytics, and is not shared with anyone. Clearing your browser cookies removes it.

hero.sub: BLNK Studio is a creative and digital growth studio. We help founders and brands go from unclear, inconsistent, or invisible online, to sharp, strategic, and conversion-ready.
hero.imageAlt: A BLNK designer sketching website wireframes on a tablet
hero.body: We're not a full-service agency that does everything for everyone. We're a focused studio that takes on brands we genuinely believe in, and builds digital foundations that work long after the project ends.

story.p2: Their websites were unclear. Their social media was inconsistent. Their brand looked like it was built in a hurry, because it was.
story.p3: BLNK was built to solve that: to bring together strategy, creative, and digital in one place, so brands could stop patching together freelancers and start working from a clear plan.
story.heading: Brands have great products. Most just can't communicate them.
story.p1: The frustration that built BLNK Studio was simple: too many good businesses were invisible online, not because they lacked quality, but because their digital presence didn't reflect it.
story.p4: We're precise, opinionated, and direct about what we think will work. We don't say yes to everything. But when we do take on a project, we take it seriously.

principles.p3Body: Beautiful is not enough. Every piece of work we produce is measured against one question: does this help the brand grow?
principles.heading: A few things we believe in, and a few we won't compromise on.
principles.body: Principles aren't decoration. They're how we decide what to build, what to push back on, and what to walk away from.
principles.p1Body: We won't design a logo before we understand your positioning. We won't write copy before we understand your audience. Strategy is not a premium add-on. It's the starting point.
principles.p2Body: One great asset won't fix a broken brand. A system will. We build brand systems, visual, verbal, and content, that work together.
principles.p4Body: If we think your brief needs rethinking, we'll say so. If the market has shifted and your strategy needs to shift with it, we'll tell you before you waste budget.

detail.heading: Every service, broken down.
detail.d1Title: Your brand is not your logo. But your logo is where it starts.
detail.d1P1: A brand identity is the visual and verbal system that tells people who you are before you say a word. When it's working, it builds recognition. When it's not, it creates doubt.
detail.d1P2: We build brand identities from strategy, not aesthetics. That means we understand your positioning, your competitors, and your audience before a single concept is designed.
detail.d1Deliverables: Logo suite · Typography system · Colour palette · Brochures & product booklets · Brand guidelines · Messaging framework · Tone of voice guide
detail.d1Best: Founders at launch · Businesses that have outgrown their original brand · Personal brands building authority
detail.d2Title: A website that converts is built differently than one that just looks good.
detail.d2P1: Most websites fail because they're designed before they're strategised. The copy is vague, the structure doesn't guide anyone, and the calls to action are buried.
detail.d2P2: We reverse that process. Strategy and copy first, then design. The result is a site that's clear, fast, and built to turn visitors into enquiries.
detail.d2Deliverables: Website strategy · Sitemap and wireframes · UX copy and messaging · UI design · CMS build (Webflow, WordPress, Framer) · SEO foundations · Launch-ready QA
detail.d2Best: Brands with an outdated or underperforming site · Startups launching for the first time · Service businesses that need their website to generate leads
detail.d3Title: Posting is not a strategy. This is.
detail.d3P1: Social media only works when there's a system behind it. A content strategy that understands the platform, the audience, and the business goal, and creative that actually stops the scroll.
detail.d3P2: We run your social media like it's our own, with direction, consistency, and monthly reporting that tells you what's working.
detail.d3Deliverables: Platform strategy · Monthly content calendar · Creative direction and design · Caption writing · Scheduling and publishing · Monthly performance report
detail.d3Best: D2C brands · Service businesses · Founders building thought leadership · Brands that want to grow an audience that buys
detail.d4Title: The best time to invest in SEO was a year ago. The second best is now.
detail.d4P1: SEO is the only marketing channel that compounds over time. Done right, it brings in leads while you sleep, without paying per click.
detail.d4P2: We combine technical SEO, strategic content, and real keyword research to help you rank for the searches that actually matter to your business.
detail.d4Deliverables: Technical SEO audit · Keyword mapping · On-page optimisation · Content strategy and briefs · Link-building guidance · Monthly reporting
detail.d4Best: Businesses with a 6–12 month horizon · Service businesses with local intent · Content-driven brands · Startups building organic pipelines
detail.d5Title: Words that rank, read, and convert.
detail.d5P1: Good content writing is invisible. The reader doesn't notice it because it answers their question, sounds right, and leads them somewhere useful. Bad content writing is everywhere.
detail.d5P2: We write website copy, blog articles, and brand messaging that serves both the search engine and the human reading it.
detail.d5Deliverables: Website copy · Blog articles · Brand messaging · Email sequences · Product descriptions · Landing pages · UX microcopy
detail.d5Best: Brands that need consistent content · Founders who hate writing their own copy · Any website that needs to rank and convert
detail.d6Title: Paid ads should pay. Here's how we make sure they do.
detail.d6P1: Running ads without a strategy is how brands burn budget. We build performance campaigns from the offer up, making sure the creative, the targeting, and the landing page are all aligned before a single rupee is spent.
detail.d6P2: Platforms: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) · Google Ads · LinkedIn Ads.
detail.d6Deliverables: Campaign strategy · Ad copywriting · Creative direction · Audience and targeting setup · A/B testing · Weekly monitoring · Monthly optimisation reports
detail.d6Best: Brands with a proven offer ready to scale · E-commerce and D2C brands · B2B brands targeting specific decision-makers
detail.d7Title: Your deck needs to work in a room where you're not talking.
detail.d7P1: Investors, clients, and partners make decisions fast. Your pitch deck needs to communicate clearly, quickly, and memorably, even when you're not in the room.
detail.d7P2: We build decks that are strategically structured, beautifully designed, and written for the audience they're going to.
detail.d7Deliverables: Narrative structure · Slide-by-slide copywriting · Visual design · Data visualisation · Pitch coaching notes (optional) · Editable master file
detail.d7Best: Founders raising a seed or Series A · Sales teams pitching enterprise clients · Brands presenting at events or conferences

faq.heading: Questions we get a lot.
faq.q1: How long does a project typically take?
faq.a1: Brand identity: 3–5 weeks. Websites: 4–8 weeks. Pitch decks: 1–2 weeks. Ongoing retainers run month-to-month. We'll always give you a timeline before we start.
faq.q2: How many revision rounds are included?
faq.a2: All projects include 2 structured revision rounds. Additional rounds are available, and we'll tell you the cost upfront.
faq.q3: Do you work with clients outside India?
faq.a3: Yes. We work with founders and brands across India, the Gulf, the UK, and the US. All projects are managed remotely.
faq.q4: Can I hire BLNK for just one service?
faq.a4: Absolutely. You don't have to take everything. Most clients start with one service and expand when they see the results.
faq.q5: What do you need from me to get started?
faq.a5: A brief (we'll give you a template), a 30-minute discovery call, and an idea of your timeline and goals. We handle everything from there.
faq.a6: Yes, on request. We treat all client information as confidential regardless.
faq.a7: Projects are typically split 50% upfront, 50% on completion. Retainers are billed monthly in advance.
